about: module clientgen's mutants (wf10 GEN-MODEL): each is judged by the module's laws (scripts/examples -modules clientgen). The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: smithy-trait-dropped
mutants.from:
if has(knownTraits, m.Key) {
			out = out.Append(Known{Id: m.Key, Value: m.Value})
mutants.rule: No trait is dropped: each is read as Known or kept as Refused, by name: EveryTraitReadOrRefused.

mutants.name: smithy-prune-drops-error
mutants.rule: Prune keeps an operation's error shapes and what they reach: PruneKeepsClosure.

mutants.name: smithy-prune-drops-map-value
mutants.rule: Prune keeps a map's value target: PruneKeepsClosure; the member list also feeds WriteReadRoundTrips through Refusals' walk.

mutants.name: smithy-drop-misses-member
mutants.from: Member{Name: m.Name, Target: m.Target, Traits: strippedTraits(m.Traits, drop)}
mutants.rule: A dropped trait appears nowhere in the slice, members included: PruneKeepsClosure (drawn members carry the droppable traits).
